title: Large Language Models for Quantum Code Translation: An Exploratory Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.34841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum software development is challenged by quantum-mechanical semantics and fragmented software development kits (SDKs), which complicate cross-SDK code translation and execution. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based approach for translating executable programs between high-level quantum SDKs. We develop a quantum-aware translation workflow whose prompt design and validation reflect quantum semantics and accommodate the version evolution of quantum ecosystems. We conduct a preliminary evaluation of 4 LLM configurations on 43 tasks, translating Qiskit programs to PennyLane and Q#. LLMs achieve a zero-shot Pass@1 of up to 72.33%, while one-shot prompting further improves the translation effectiveness. These results suggest potential for quantum code translation by LLMs.

translated_title: 面向量子代码翻译的大语言模型：一项探索性研究
translated_abstract: 量子软件开发面临着量子力学语义和碎片化软件开发工具包（SDK）带来的挑战，这使得跨SDK的代码翻译和执行变得复杂。本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的方法，用于在高级量子SDK之间翻译可执行程序。我们开发了一种量子感知的翻译工作流，其提示词设计和验证过程反映了量子语义，并能适应量子生态系统的版本演进。我们在43个任务上对4种大语言模型配置进行了初步评估，将Qiskit程序翻译为PennyLane和Q#。大语言模型实现了高达72.33%的零样本Pass@1，而单样本提示进一步提升了解译效果。这些结果表明大语言模型在量子代码翻译方面具有潜力。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种量子感知的基于大语言模型的代码翻译工作流，能够将Qiskit程序翻译为PennyLane和Q#，零样本Pass@1最高达72.33%，展示出LLM在跨量子SDK代码翻译方面的巨大潜力。
